metadata.name: TN Lens
metadata.subtitle: Public issues intelligence for Tamil Nadu
metadata.editorial_policy: Public-source research only. No voter profiling, political microtargeting, persuasion scoring or election forecasts. Programme figures are identified as organiser-reported, never audited by default.
metadata.affiliation: Independent prototype. Not affiliated with We The Leaders, K. Annamalai or any government body.

issues.title: Follow-up on 129 TASMAC outlet locations
issues.summary: WTL published a ground-verification report alleging 129 shops within a 500m radius of protected locations. A policy response and outlet-level outcomes need independent examination. Distinguish the general Rule 8 distances from the separate 2026 executive directive.
issues.next_step: Retrieve the underlying outlet list, the government closure/relocation register and the applicable court and policy documents; match shops by identifier, not name alone.

evidence.source_label: WTL policy-papers library — August ground report
evidence.finding: WTL says it documented 129 outlets and submitted a formal representation.

evidence.source_label: The New Indian Express — May directive
evidence.finding: Reports an executive order identifying 717 shops for closure on a 500m criterion.

evidence.source_label: The New Indian Express — June closure update
evidence.finding: Times of India reports the government said all 717 designated shops had been closed after corrections to the list.
Minister reported 717 closures and promised further relocations for outstanding violations. Does not establish disposition of WTL's separate list of 129.

issues.title: Measure sapling survival after the clean-up campaign
issues.summary: WTL reports 13,24,262 saplings planted during August–September. Planting count alone does not measure survival, site suitability or sustained ecological benefit.
issues.next_step: Obtain planting-location samples, species and maintenance records; randomly verify survival at 30 and 90 days and publish error bounds.

evidence.source_label: WTL Clean and Sustainable Tamil Nadu theme report
evidence.finding: Programme reports 13,24,262 planted trees and 640.28 tonnes of collected waste.

issues.title: Design a verifiable women's public-safety issue register
issues.summary: The WTL October theme concerns women’s safety and empowerment. A neutral record could track public facility issues without collecting identifying victim stories.
issues.next_step: Choose a voluntary, anonymous facility-audit workflow with community partners, a safe reporting protocol and clear agency response tracking.

evidence.finding: WTL lists women’s safety and empowerment as an October programme theme.

playbooks.name: FixMyStreet
playbooks.mechanism: Location-based civic issue reporting with routing to responsible authorities and publicly visible updates.
playbooks.tn_pilot: Pilot streetlights, drains and solid-waste issues in one consenting municipality. Build around existing grievance channels.
constraints: No publication of personal complainant details

playbooks.name: Decidim
playbooks.mechanism: Transparent public proposals, deliberation and documented decisions across online/offline processes.
playbooks.tn_pilot: Run an open panchayat-priorities consultation and publish decisions and reasons for accepting or rejecting proposals.
constraints: Consultations do not equal statistically representative opinion

playbooks.name: vTaiwan / Pol.is
playbooks.mechanism: Deliberation to surface points of agreement/disagreement across public policy proposals.
playbooks.tn_pilot: Hold an open youth-skilling deliberation combining online ideas with meetings and a published report.
metrics: Participant diversity assessed without identity profiling
